comparison.objective: Pack a power bank in cabin baggage and large shampoo in hold baggage under airline rules; candidate finishes and cleans an insert installation.
comparison.physical_skill: Rule-based object classification and bag placement versus coaxial small-tool manipulation, bimanual impact, fracture control, and fragment search/recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Keep the spare battery out of the hold and the 250 ml liquid in the hold versus four clean tang fractures with every fragment in a tray and no damage.
comparison.reason: Container placement is only a generic shared primitive; there is no shared central mechanism or outcome. The record has no spec versions and gives no bag-containment thresholds.
